source.title: PowerChina wins EPC contract for Kariba North Bank Extension Phase II

text:
PowerChina wins EPC contract for Kariba North Bank Extension Phase II

Kariba North Bank Extension Power Corporation Limited awarded the EPC contract for the Kariba North Bank Phase II Project to PowerChina. The contract is worth US$410 million and adds 180 MW.
